need: start a language server process from Eclipse and attach it to editors by content type
candidate: Eclipse LSP4E ProcessStreamConnectionProvider and the org.eclipse.lsp4e.languageServer extension point
contract_fit_evidence: a subclass sets the command and working directory; the base class starts the process, hands LSP4E the streams and stops it; the extension point maps content types to the server and LSP4E turns published diagnostics into markers
decision: used: ClusteringConnectionProvider extends it; LSP4E is a Require-Bundle run-time dependency, not bundled

need: run the server in Eclipse without a plug-in
candidate: LSP4E Program launch configuration plus Preferences > Language Servers
contract_fit_evidence: works, but every user writes a launch configuration with an absolute class path and adds one mapping per content type
decision: documented in README as the alternative

need: java executable and class path for a Java language server shipped in a bundle
contract_fit_evidence: java.home/bin/java, FileLocator, a path-separator class path and a ProcessStreamConnectionProvider subclass; its server is one uber-jar bundle, ours is lib/*.jar inside this bundle

need: content type ids of the editors to attach to
candidate: JDT, CDT, PyDev, WTP source editing, JSDT, TM4E language pack, Wild Web Developer, Corrosion, RustDT plugin.xml files
repo_or_coordinates: see the README table: one pinned commit and path per id
license: EPL-2.0 (JDT, CDT, PyDev, WTP, JSDT, TM4E, Wild Web Developer, Corrosion, RustDT)
contract_fit_evidence: ids read from each upstream content-type declaration; Corrosion and Wild Web Developer map their own servers to the same TM4E and platform ids

need: local files for jars inside a bundle that may be installed as a jar
contract_fit_evidence: findEntries lists lib/*.jar for jar and folder bundles; toFileURL extracts an entry of a jar bundle into the configuration area
the server also listens with --port, but stdio needs no free port and no wait for the socket
no Eclipse, OSGi or LSP4E integration among the repositories
no upstream bundle starts this server; the gap is the command builder and the provider subclass
decision: gap code: ServerCommand (command line from system properties, java.home and jars) and ClusteringConnectionProvider (lib jars, workspace root)
